task: baseline eyes-open versus eyes-closed; not drowsiness or diagnosis
feature_specification: Per-channel log10 absolute power in four bands plus four relative band powers; 512 features for 64 channels. Relative denominator is integrated 1-40 Hz Welch PSD. Features use volts from MNE.
notes: Freeze before fitting. Do not change subjects, preprocessing, candidates, split, or selection after seeing holdout results.
Subject allocation is GroupShuffleSplit with split_seed and test_fraction; feature preparation does not inspect model predictions.
All participant windows remain in the same partition and every inner fold. Fit scalers only on training folds.
Choose model solely from mean inner grouped cross-validation balanced accuracy; deterministic alphabetical name tie break.
Report selected model and dummy on final holdout; no further tuning after opening it.
Reject malformed or unverifiable files; report fixed signal-QC exclusions. Do not silently skip missing participants.
Offline zero-phase filtering is not online inference. Baseline run identity is confounded with condition and recorded in fixed order. Same-dataset holdout is not external validation.
integration: trapezoid on low <= frequency < high, including the 1-40 Hz total-power denominator
filter_scope: per entire recording, zero-phase SOS, before start trim and non-overlapping epochs; no learned preprocessing

quality_control.nonfinite_recording: exclude all candidate windows; fail preparation if any participant loses either class
quality_control.flat_epoch: exclude if any raw channel has exact zero peak-to-peak before filtering

primary_holdout_statistic: pooled-window balanced accuracy; resample complete held-out participants and recompute the same pooled statistic
